finding.description: Batch-selection defect: both 3×3 upper matrices have negative top-left entries (-9, -3), while both lower matrices have positive entries (9, 6). The sole 2×2 matrix is diagonal. This rule succeeds on only 15/30 independent controls, so the finding is batch-specific.
